## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
Running status should use the same revision identifier as deployment history so operators can match entries for the same deployment.

## Changes
The pull request adds a running status formatter that displays a shortened revision and an attempt number. It also adds tests for the status prefix, attempt suffix, and attempt label.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/display.py:14 — correctness — Use the history revision identifier in running status — For revision `0123456789abcdef` on attempt 2, status shows `0123456` while history shows `0123456789ab`. The docstring promises “the same identifier as history,” but status uses `revision[:7]` and history uses `revision[:12]`. — Operators comparing running status with history see different identifiers for the same deployment. — Fix: Use the 12-character revision and extend `test_running_status_contains_attempt` to check the full status line.
